say:1:1330367001:1.text: She looked so healthy a short while back. Even made it to the festival. We all thought she had finally recovered.
say:1:1330367001:1.source_cn: 公主前段时间气色那么好，还参加了祭典，大家都以为公主的...
say:1:1330367001:1.male: She looked so healthy a short while back. Even made it to the festival. We all thought she had finally recovered.
say:1:1330367001:1.female: She looked so healthy a short while back. Even made it to the festival. We all thought she had finally recovered.

say:2:1330367002:1.text: Never did we think we'd be attending her funeral instead.
say:2:1330367002:1.source_cn: 没想到最后等来的却是她的葬礼。
say:2:1330367002:1.male: Never did we think we'd be attending her funeral instead.
say:2:1330367002:1.female: Never did we think we'd be attending her funeral instead.

say:3:1330367003:1.text: Princess Yolena was so lively, so kind, and she treated everyone like a friend...
say:3:1330367003:1.source_cn: 多么可爱活泼又亲民的亚莲娜公主啊……
say:3:1330367003:1.male: Princess Yolena was so lively, so kind, and she treated everyone like a friend...
say:3:1330367003:1.female: Princess Yolena was so lively, so kind, and she treated everyone like a friend...
